description: Look up one paper by DOI, arXiv ID, OpenAlex ID, zotero: ID or local: ID: title, authors, date, venue, all IDs, licence, open copies with their licences, abstract and a citation line. arXiv IDs come from arXiv with the paper's licence; DOIs from OpenAlex, then SportRxiv or Crossref. Use it to check that a reference exists and says what is claimed.

id.description: A DOI (10.1145/3292500.3330758 or https://doi.org/...), an arXiv ID or URL (1802.07127, arxiv.org/abs/1802.07127), or an OpenAlex ID (W4288278931).

name: get_paper
